title: xplace certs AI artifact workflow
description: Validate the xplace-certs manifest and generate/read-only-check AI artifacts for internal repo workflows.
commands: npm run xapps -- ai plan --mode internal --from apps/publishers/xplace-example/xapps/xplace-certs/manifest.json --preset internal-v1 --flow xplace-certs --json --out {{ARTIFACTS_DIR}}/xapps-xplace-certs.plan.json

npm run xapps -- ai check --mode internal --plan {{ARTIFACTS_DIR}}/xapps-xplace-certs.plan.json --policy apps/publishers/xplace-example/xapps/xplace-certs/ai/policy.readonly.internal-v1.json --json --out {{ARTIFACTS_DIR}}/xapps-xplace-certs.check.json
